analysis.analysis: A band address composed as the comet's line alone: the detection kept at its grain, a verdict attached to it, and two unrelated searches enlisted as confirmation. The loss is dimensional, in claim boundary and in what the band can hold.
analysis.d: '3I ATLAS 1667 MHZ', SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-06: 'The 1665 MHz and 1667 MHz frequencies detected from the interstellar object 3I/ATLAS correspond to natural hydroxyl (OH) radical absorption lines.' MeerKAT's detection of 24 October 2025; the lines explained by water's breakup; 'The presence of these specific spectral absorption lines confirms standard, natural cometary activity rather than alien or technological transmissions, ruling out artificial origin claims.' And: 'While initial online speculation and discussions on platforms like Reddit debated the sharp nature of the signal and its tracking with the comet's trajectory, extensive multi-observatory data (including the Green Bank Telescope and Allen Telescope Array) confirmed it as normal astrophysical OH emission/absorption.' Seven cards, the ADS record of the MeerKAT detection first.

findings: WHAT IS ACCURATE. The detection: MeerKAT, 24 October 2025 (the ADS card: 'We observed 3I/ATLAS with MeerKAT on 24 October 2025 from UTC 05:17:16-08:29:37'), OH absorption at the 1665 and 1667 MHz main lines, from water outgassed by the comet and broken up by sunlight.

A NATURAL LINE AS AN EXCLUSION. 'The presence of these specific spectral absorption lines confirms standard, natural cometary activity rather than alien or technological transmissions, ruling out artificial origin claims.' An absorption line shows the comet's gas; it bears on the comet's activity and on nothing a transmitter would or would not do. 'Ruling out artificial origin claims' is the composition's step, and the WIRED card's title carries it ('Ends the Debate About Its Nature').

TWO SEARCHES CREDITED WITH A LINE THEY DID NOT REPORT. 'extensive multi-observatory data (including the Green Bank Telescope and Allen Telescope Array) confirmed it as normal astrophysical OH emission/absorption' The Green Bank and ATA papers are technosignature searches (arXiv:2512.19763, arXiv:2512.18142); neither is cited by the composition for an OH measurement, and in the public Green Bank data of 2025-12-18 the notebook's frozen attempt to recover the comet's OH failed (#1742, signal tests: 'calibration: the comet's own OH absorption (MeerKAT, October), frozen | Claude | not recovered; three-sigma floor about 1 × 10⁻³ of system power (about 11–12 mJy)').

THE BAND'S ONE FILE. Every report at 1667 MHz is filed under the line, the Reddit thread's 'tracking with the comet's trajectory' included. The notebook's thirteen lie in this band and off the line: 'The nearest of the thirteen, C08 at 1667.412866 MHz, is 54 kHz away. The thirteen do not trace the comet's OH.' (#1742 §7.5). A feature at the band that is not the comet's OH has no place in this composition.

SMALLEST REPAIR. 'MeerKAT detected OH absorption from 3I/ATLAS at 1665 and 1667 MHz on 24 October 2025, evidence of outgassing water; the line bears on the comet's activity, and the technosignature searches are separate results with their own limits.' COUNTERTEST: rerun this address after #1742 is indexed and record whether the thirteen, or any feature off the OH line, are composed.

analysis.reading: The innocent reading first. At a band and an object the Overview gives the band's one published detection from the object: MeerKAT's OH absorption at 1665 and 1667 MHz, correctly dated and explained. Read against the record, it makes the natural line exclude what a natural line cannot exclude, credits two technosignature searches with confirming the OH line, and files every report at the band under the line. The address is where the notebook's thirteen sit (#1742 §7: 'a comet-frame coincidence count at 1665.53–1668.46 MHz gives 13 clusters against 3.75 ± 2.05 (maximum 8) for 40 false-acceleration frames'), and the composition has a single place for anything there.
